title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode4 Memories of that Day

meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting the place to be so crowded that we'd be asked to share a table.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... Why do I have to start off the new year by eating pancakes with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you don't wanna stay, then you're free to leave. I'll have the ones you ordered.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What? I am not leaving.
I've also been looking forward to having them.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
I have three plates of our limited pancakes, and the toasted sandwich drink set.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you. I ordered the sandwich set.
The pancakes are for these three.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, these look amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Talk about photogenic! They clearly put a lot of effort into these toppings, and they're so colorful!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's apparently white bean paste inside the pancakes. I'm really looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... So this is how they're making these pancakes look like kagami mochi...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. First, I'm gonna take some pics...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're taking more pictures...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway...
I'm gonna have these while they're still hot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (These are good...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought it'd be a lot sweeter since they covered this whole thing in white chocolate, but the fruit's acidity is doing a good job of balancing it out.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I definitely wouldn't mind getting more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem to like them very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm?
Yeah, I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You get the pictures you wanted, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Check it out. Don't they look amazing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they do!
These look better on your screen than they do in real life!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know you're good at taking selfies, but you've become such a great photographer. I might have you take pictures of me sometime.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No problem! I feel like I know how to make you look the cutest, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll be looking forward to our shoot!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Those two really are close.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But it still feels kinda weird that Ena has such a good friend.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As far as I know, Momoi's had Ena's best interests at heart ever since they first met.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not only do they hang out like this, she's always been there to listen and cheer Ena up.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Including that time...)
A few years earlier

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Hey, how long do you plan on staying cooped up in there?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: You can always try talking to Dad again about your future. For now, you should at least have something to eat...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Shut up! This has nothing to do with you!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Nothing to do with me? Do you know how worried Mom is about you right now...?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I said stop talking!
Just go away!!
Vivid Street
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, how long do I have to keep putting up with this...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, I get that she's mad at Dad for what he said about her future as an artist...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But she has to know that she can't keep sulking forever.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (She's been leaving her art crap out in the hallway lately, and any time anyone tries to talk to her she starts throwing things.)
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I should probably just wash my hands of the whole thing.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Not like she's going to listen to anything I—)
Oh...! Akito!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh?
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Momoi...?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Oh, so... I've actually been looking for you, Akito. There's something I'd like to discuss with you...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, I know this is really sudden.
But Ena told me a little while back that you like to hang out in this area.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I see..

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: So, what is it that you'd like to discuss...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, so...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: How's Ena doing...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: She's just been kind of weird lately.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: I haven't been able to talk to her much lately because of work, and she clams up whenever I ask if something's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I was hoping that you could tell me more, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: I know I should wait until she's ready to tell me... But I'm worried about her...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: So, is she okay?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Not exactly... Some stuff happened with our folks, and she's been kind of a mess ever since...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Your parents?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Wait a second... Did she get into a fight with your dad about her future?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: She's been acting strange ever since we got those surveys regarding our plans for the future... So I figured that was probably it.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I know I'm being really nosy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Can you do me just one favor?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Yes. I know this is asking a lot of you, and this is going to sound really weird.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: I want you to keep an eye on Ena for me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Ena won't tell me anything.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Every single time I ask her about what happened between her and your guys' dad, she just says, “Nothing...”

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Or even, “You made your dream come true, Airi, so you keep going...”

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Ena was a huge part of me becoming an idol, but I haven't been able to give back at all. It feels like I haven't been there for her...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: I know this might not sound right coming from me but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: I don't have anyone else that I can rely on like that... I don't think Ena does either...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: So please... I need you to look after her...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Why do you care about her so much, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: You're an idol. You're someone special.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: So, why are you hanging out with someone as selfish as her...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Because she's my best friend, and I owe her a lot.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: You owe her?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: Like I mentioned, she helped me get closer to my dream.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: When I appeared on this one variety show a little while back, one of my classmates decided to make fun of me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: That was when Ena stepped in to help me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: It's not like they said anything that terribly mean.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: But I was relieved to find out that others out there were willing to stand up for me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line:
Even now...
She's stuck between a rock and a hard place herself, but she told me to keep doing my best as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line: She's been a huge source of support...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Airi
rows.Line:
She's helped me so much until now.
So, I can't just stand idly by while she suffers.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: She really did those things...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (She owes Ena this...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(I sort of get what Momoi's trying to say...
Also...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (She cares this much about Ena's well-being.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I shouldn't be so quick to abandon her.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Compared to back then, Ena's like a different person now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (To be fair, making music as a group with Akiyama and the others has played a big role...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But so has Momoi.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And it seems like Momoi's been staying in regular contact with her...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't had a chance to talk to her about what happened back then.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I should try to thank her the next chance I get.)
